tools.name: evaluate_floor_ceil(floor_value, ceil_value)
tools.description:
def evaluate_floor_ceil(floor_value, ceil_value):
    """
    Evaluates the sum of the floor of a number and the ceiling of another number.

    Parameters:
    floor_value (float): The number to take the floor of.
    ceil_value (float): The number to take the ceiling of.

    Returns:
    int: The sum of the floor of floor_value and the ceiling of ceil_value.
    """
    return math.floor(floor_value) + math.ceil(ceil_value)

tools.name: find_object_purpose(image: Image, object_name: str, query: str) -> str
tools.description:
def find_object_purpose(image: Image, object_name: str, query: str) -> str:
    '''Find the purpose of an object in an image.
    
    Args:
        image (Image): The image to check.
        object_name (str): The name of the object to find the purpose of.
        query (str): The original query to answer.
       
    Returns:
        str: The purpose of the object.
    '''
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    object_patches = image_patch.find(object_name)
    object_patch = object_patches[0]
    answer = object_patch.llm_query(query, long_answer=True)
    return answer
